title: Count Employees per Department
description: Count the number of employees in each department using GROUP BY.

data.text: Write a query to count how many employees exist in each department in the `Employees` table.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT Department, COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount
FROM Employees
GROUP BY Department
ORDER BY EmployeeCount DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: GROUP BY groups rows that share the same Department value. COUNT(*) counts every row in each group. Always alias aggregate columns (EmployeeCount) for readability. ORDER BY at the end sorts the grouped result.
